questions.q: Why does a batch cost you latency?
options: All images in it finish together, after the whole job
It reloads the model per image
questions.answer: All images in it finish together, after the whole job
questions.why: The first image appears when the whole job is done.

questions.q: A worker gets one 5 s job every 5.5 s. What should you expect?
options: Waits several times the job length, since it's 91% busy
questions.answer: Waits several times the job length, since it's 91% busy

questions.q: Why does sticky routing help with several models?
options: It avoids model loads, which dominate the cost here
It makes jobs faster on the GPU
It uses more memory per job
questions.answer: It avoids model loads, which dominate the cost here
questions.why: The lab's loads fall from 203 to 59 at four workers.

questions.q: How do you add a second GPU to serve more jobs in core ComfyUI?
options: Run a second process, and route jobs between them yourself
questions.answer: Run a second process, and route jobs between them yourself
questions.why: We found no built-in cluster. --cuda-device and --port set up each process.

questions.q: Why can't a client ask any worker for a job's status?
options: Each process has its own queue and history
questions.answer: Each process has its own queue and history
questions.why: A prompt_id only means something to the server that took it.
